what: Pins on the guide map drop from 60px above and bounce into place 1.5s after the panel appears (.6s overshoot curve, .1s stagger). From 4s on, the chosen pins’ speech bubbles pop out one after another every 6s, scaling .5→1.08→.97→1 (.45s). Clicking a pin opens or closes it, and clicking the panel closes it. 10s after a click, the cycle restarts from the beginning. Hovering a pin scales its icon to 1.1x (.3s). Used on facility guide maps, campus maps, and store floor plans.

options.start: Wait before the first pin after the panel attaches (s), default 1.5
options.each: Gap between pins (seconds), default 0.1 — if a pin has data-delay, that value is used
options.first: Delay before the speech bubble cycle starts (s), default 4
options.cycle: Duration one speech bubble floats (s), default 6
options.resume: Time before the cycle restarts after pressing (sec), default 10
options.order: Pin numbers to cycle through (from 1, comma-separated), default all
options.[data-fx-part=pin]: Pin (child) — data-dir sets the side the bubble attaches to (bottom-right·top-right·right·bottom-left·bottom·left), data-delay sets its own delay
options.[data-fx-part=balloon]: Speech bubble inside a pin — position comes from the consuming css. If it holds a link, tapping does not close it but follows the link

use: Speech bubble

from.where: index.html [data-slot=hero-map] Seven magnifier pins on the hand-drawn facility map
